decisions.boundary_condition: Apply the price preference only among options that meet explicit trip requirements; price does not override requested timing, nonstop service, Wi-Fi, or acceptable layover constraints
decisions.canonical_value: Prefer the lowest-priced flight among options that satisfy the trip's explicit requirements, while allowing a more expensive option when the cheapest violates a must-have or entails an unacceptable itinerary tradeoff.
decisions.condition: When comparing flight options for a trip after accounting for stated timing, routing, connectivity, and onboard-feature requirements
decisions.default_action: Rank acceptable options by total price and prefer the cheapest
decisions.exception_condition: Prefer a more expensive option when the cheapest option violates a stated must-have or has an explicitly unacceptable layover or itinerary tradeoff
decisions.name: Cheapest acceptable flight
decisions.preference_value: lowest-priced flight that satisfies explicit itinerary and amenity requirements
decisions.rationale: Both candidates express the same recurring price-first policy within an acceptable option set; the second candidate makes explicit the constraints and fallback already implicit in the first candidate's boundary.
